fullscreen_surface_label: Example fullscreen, theater-mode, and immersive-player posture for official voter-information media routes
delivery_role_note: The service reviews same-device immersive player modes so fullscreen, theater mode, and forced-fullscreen playback remain subordinate to the full recording and the current written help lane rather than quietly becoming a stripped-down stand-alone official answer surface.

reviewed_immersive_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether fullscreen hides or deprioritizes the date, scope, correction, or help-route cues that keep the recording subordinate to the current written official answer.
Reviewed whether large-player layouts leave the written FAQ/help lane below the fold or otherwise make the recording look self-sufficient before the voter rechecks the current route.
Reviewed whether mobile or embedded playback can open directly into fullscreen and whether the voter still has a practical path back to the current official page or named help lane.
Reviewed whether player settings, iframe attributes, policy, or constrained-container behavior make fullscreen unavailable or materially different across contexts.

immersive_boundary_note: Fullscreen and theater-mode presentations are treated as viewing conveniences around the official recording, not as replacements for the full watch page, linked FAQ/help route, or correction posture.
context_visibility_note: The service reviews which freshness, scope, and help cues move off-screen or disappear once the player expands and does not treat the immersive player as self-sufficient authority.
fullscreen_availability_note: Where fullscreen or large-player availability can vary by player, embed, iframe, or browser/container policy, the service avoids promising universal support and records which immersive modes were actually reviewed.
source_page_recovery_note: When immersive player modes are available, the voter should still have a practical route back to the current source page, current written help entry, or named office contact before acting on volatile instructions.
related_detachment_note: If immersive playback later detaches into PiP, background play, or popout, the route treats that as a separate `502` event rather than proof that fullscreen alone was sufficient.
related_second_screen_note: If playback later moves onto a TV or other second screen, the route treats that as a separate `503` event rather than proof that same-device immersive playback remained the controlling answer lane.
